pr.title: fix(Stripe Trigger Node): Use stored webhook secret for request verification

reviews.body:
**No issues found** across 3 files

<details>
<summary>Architecture diagram</summary>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Stripe as Stripe API
    participant Trigger as Stripe Trigger Node (webhook)
    participant SigHelpers as StripeTriggerHelpers
    participant GenVerifier as Generic Signature Verifier
    participant CredStore as Credential Store
    participant WfData as Workflow Static Data
    participant Response as HTTP Response

    Note over Stripe,Response: Webhook Signature Verification Flow

    Stripe->>Trigger: POST /webhook (stripe-signature header, raw body)
    Trigger->>SigHelpers: verifySignature()
    
    SigHelpers->>SigHelpers: NEW: getSigningSecret()
    
    alt NEW: Stored webhook secret exists
        SigHelpers->>WfData: getWorkflowStaticData('node').webhookSecret
        WfData-->>SigHelpers: webhookSecret (string)
    else NEW: No stored secret, fallback to credential secret
        SigHelpers->>WfData: getWorkflowStaticData('node').webhookSecret
        WfData-->>SigHelpers: undefined
        SigHelpers->>CredStore: getCredentials('stripeApi').signatureSecret
        CredStore-->>SigHelpers: credential secret (string)
    else Neither secret available
        SigHelpers->>WfData: getWorkflowStaticData('node').webhookSecret
        WfData-->>SigHelpers: undefined
        SigHelpers->>CredStore: getCredentials('stripeApi').signatureSecret
        CredStore-->>SigHelpers: undefined/null
        SigHelpers-->>Trigger: true (skip verification)
    end

    alt Secret found (from either source)
        SigHelpers->>SigHelpers: Parse t= and v1= from signature header
        SigHelpers->>GenVerifier: verifySignature({ getExpectedSignature, getActualSignature, getTimestamp })
        
        GenVerifier->>SigHelpers: getTimestamp()
        SigHelpers->>Stripe: (from header) t= value
        GenVerifier->>GenVerifier: Check timestamp tolerance (5 minutes)
        
        alt Timestamp valid
            GenVerifier->>SigHelpers: getExpectedSignature()
            SigHelpers->>SigHelpers: HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + "." + rawBody)
            SigHelpers-->>GenVerifier: computed signature
            
            GenVerifier->>SigHelpers: getActualSignature()
            SigHelpers->>Stripe: (from header) v1= value
            SigHelpers-->>GenVerifier: provided signature
            
            GenVerifier->>GenVerifier: timing-safe compare
            
            alt Signatures match
                GenVerifier-->>Trigger: true
                Trigger-->>Response: 200 OK
            else Signatures mismatch
                GenVerifier-->>Trigger: false
                Trigger->>Response: 401 Unauthorized
            end
        else Timestamp stale (>5 min)
            GenVerifier-->>Trigger: false
            Trigger->>Response: 401 Unauthorized
        end
    end
```
</details>
